review.copilot.microsoft.copilot.formerl: Microsoft Copilot (formerly Bing Chat) is Microsoft's AI assistant powered by OpenAI's GPT-4 technology. What makes Copilot remarkable is that it offers free access to GPT-4 and DALL-E 3 image generation - features that require paid subscriptions on ChatGPT.
review.copilot.copilot.is.deeply.integra: Copilot is deeply integrated into the Microsoft ecosystem. It's built into Windows 11, Edge browser, Bing search, and Microsoft 365 applications. This integration means you can access AI assistance anywhere you work within Microsoft's products.
review.copilot.for.users.heavily.investe: For users heavily invested in Microsoft's ecosystem, Copilot offers unique value. With Copilot Pro and Microsoft 365 Copilot, you can use AI directly in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook to draft documents, analyze data, create presentations, and manage emails.
Use GPT-4 without paying. The only major AI assistant offering free access to the most powerful model.
review.copilot.generate.high-quality.ima: Generate high-quality images with DALL-E 3 for free. 15 boosts per day, unlimited with Pro.
review.copilot.built.into.windows.11.wit: Built into Windows 11 with Win+C shortcut. Access AI assistance anywhere on your PC.
